$comment: Configuration for the HyperFrames engine, matched to the real CLI (hyperframes render, verified against v0.7.68). Adjust here if your installed version changes. Verify with `npx hyperframes render --help`. Do NOT hand-edit generated compositions — regenerate them from graphics/plan.json.

render.$comment_shape: Real usage: hyperframes render <PROJECT_DIR> -c compositions/<beat>.html -o <out> --format mov -f <fps>. The project dir is a positional arg; the composition is referenced relative to it.
render.$comment_format: mov = ProRes 4444 with alpha; webm = VP9 with alpha. Both composite over footage. mov is the most compatible with ffmpeg overlay.

browser.$comment: Chrome Headless Shell is required for local rendering; this installs/caches it.

transcribe.$comment: Bundled word-level transcription (whisper.cpp / Parakeet). Preferred over a separate WhisperX install; writes into the project dir.
